slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: The official settlement value published by the source named in the rules (for example the NWS Daily Climate Report) versus my logged pre-resolution prediction…
The public-METAR-only control arm trading identical windows: the sensor arm must beat it on Brier score and net expected value with a bootstrap 95%…
